title: HandUpdate
description: This is a mod for the better hand
body:
This mod is a little mod because it is my first mod and it's for the event of LHAIRISSON LE BG a french modding youtou-beurre !
In my mod there are Items; Boss; and dimension !
That's all !
Thanks if you download !!
I continue with more information : 
This mod is a basic mod where you do visit the world and find the Hand boss. With this mob you can drop "Chair"×1. 
With two "Chair" and one "Bone" you can creft a sword and with a flint you can transform this sword. With the "Chair" and a "Water Siegel" you can develop the "Chair" and you get 16 "Chair Block". With that you can enter in the Chair World Dimension !!
